svg.title: SEC EDGAR Financial Lakehouse — medallion data architecture
svg.desc: Left-to-right medallion pipeline. Source: SEC EDGAR API (XBRL company-facts JSON). Bronze: Ingest & Flatten with Python and Polars, then S3 Bronze Parquet partitioned by fiscal year and form. Silver: PySpark Transform (keep 10-K/10-Q, dedupe restatements, classify periods, assign fiscal period), then S3 Silver; restatements override originals. Gold: Metric Catalog and KPI Engine, then S3 Gold with row-level lineage to the filing accession number. Serve: Streamlit Dashboard and a Lineage Table that references back to Bronze by accession number. Tech stack: Python, PySpark, Polars, AWS S3, Parquet, Streamlit.
svg.text: Validated on Apple: ~25k fact rows, 503 us-gaap tags, FY2009–FY2025
